{{Top|leg}}
A '''disruption bubble unit''' was an integral part of an [[Individual field disruptor/Legends|individual field disruptor]]. Units such as the [[Evasive-13 individual field disruptor|Evasive-13]] had two disruption bubble units each located within a projection shell. When the shells were slid away from the central [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]], the disruption bubble units were activated and enveloped the wearer in a personal [[Force field/Legends|energy field]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
